{"subject":"Congrats on the OpenAI partnership","body":"Hi,

Congrats on the OpenAI partnership in September. Becoming OpenAI's first B2B provider of open-source model inference is a big moment, and seeing open models like GLM 5.3 and Kimi K3 run natively in Codex made it feel very real.

Would you be open to a 20-minute call in the next few weeks? I'd love to hear how the team is thinking about what comes next. No agenda beyond that.

Best,
Sam"}
